---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to project diagnosis or team workflow guidance
labels: [enhancement]
---

## Problem
Describe a real project-advisory gap, not just a new feature idea.

## Smallest useful improvement
What changes would solve the problem without additional unnecessary process?

## Alternatives and cost
What is the simplest fallback? What overhead does the proposed change introduce?

## Safety and evidence
Does this affect read-only behavior, sensitive data, or recommendation confidence?
